content.problem: The identical four-independent-tendon structure must pass M1_A/M1_B/M1_C/M5.
mechanisms: The difficult historical M1_B reach is evidence of a useful geometry/control combination, not a pass of the current dense actuator envelope.
Two root-only and two full-span independent tendons separate proximal and distal authority. Preserve channel independence and compare the hardest case first before the full group.

Prior common E=12 MPa circles 8/7 mm, lengths 0.16/0.11 m, radius 14.1 mm passed A/C/M5 but failed B with 16.844 mm error, 53.49 mm/s hold speed, 44.615 mm/s tendon speed. Uniform root softening did not fix the conflict.
content.next_decision: Read the saved M1_B schedule and geometry, regenerate within the frozen domain, use native control capability and braking diagnostics, then test all four on one design.

Generate a current owned candidate. Diagnose the hardest condition using the capability catalogue and a ResearchDecision with evidence.

If a condition fails, distinguish static authority, transient tendon speed and terminal braking; choose a new evidence-based decision.
Only aggregate and select after every required case is freshly validated on the same design.
